Her waist wears a black leather waist harness of one narrow belt around her waist and a second narrow belt around her hips, joined by four thin vertical straps over her stomach with a small silver ring at every junction, framing her navel. Her left leg wears a black ribbed over-the-knee sock with two thin white stripes around the top band, hugging her left calf and knee and ending high on her left thigh, running down into her heel. Her right leg wears a black ribbed over-the-knee sock with two thin white stripes around the top band, hugging her right calf and knee and ending high on her right thigh, running down into her heel. Jewelry: a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and large drop earrings of mixed metals, a gold chain ending in a heavy silver weight on each ear, hanging above her collarbones. Jewelry is metal and pearl only.

Background: a bright white-sand beach at midday with calm turquoise water, a wooden boardwalk with a waist-high rail and a row of closed striped cabanas of normal door height, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
